items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: When he'd come over to Lake with Sam Argan... I didn't know too much about banjo... The Sam Argan, he'd play maybe in G... But it made me get more further than I was.

ctx.x: No, Wilming Paster's Town. She was. Uh-huh. And, uh, in between that, well, they, uh, she began to, well, she was a pianist, and I was just a beginner trying to learn bandwale, but I learned a lot from her, just by me going, called myself, playing just to be in the show, going to the show. But I didn't, I couldn't imagine... That wasn't your incentive. It wasn't your incentive. They were doing me so much good, you know? Right. And so, uh, I mean, it was great.
